basics.name: Jiale Zhao
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher in AI and Optimization
basics.summary: I am an undergraduate student at Beihang University. My research focuses on AI agents, large language model-driven automated algorithm design, neural network training, and combinatorial optimization. I am particularly interested in building autonomous systems that can search for programs, design complete algorithmic pipelines, and solve challenging scheduling and routing problems.

education.area: School of Automation Science and Electrical Engineering

publications.name: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization
publications.authors: Jiale Zhao, Sirui Mao, Zimu Chen, Wentao Yang, Zihan Wang, Xuefeng Huang, Junji Cheng, and Liyuanjun Lai
publications.summary: Introduces a training-free, solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Across TSP, CVRP, VRPTW, and PCTSP instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, the method achieves solution quality comparable to or better than state-of-the-art approaches while delivering an average speedup of approximately 70 times.

publications.name: DGA2D: Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design with Large Language Models
publications.authors: Jiale Zhao, Zimu Chen, Sirui Mao, Wentao Yang, Yuxiang Bai, and Liyuanjun Lai
publications.summary: Proposes a directed graph-guided framework for system-level automated algorithm design. Evaluated across 12 combinatorial optimization problems, DGA2D reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared with state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines.
